Complete original update abstract: postprimary apicoposterior and bronchogenic spread pattern; legacy frequencies not extrapolated. This source is an author update/review rather than a modern prospective diagnostic cohort.

assessmentJudgment.keys: No incorrect clinical key, DE/EN/FA polarity change or option-specific feedback mismatch identified in this bounded pool.
assessmentJudgment.plausibility: Homogeneous morphological alternatives and clinically related infection/tumour/vascular differentials; no off-topic absurd option retained. Some introductory recognition and measurement questions intentionally remain alongside longitudinal, context and diagnostic-limit cases.
assessmentJudgment.coverage: Three mapped goals cover all12 original questions and15 cards. Count is sufficient for these stated goals without an artificial quota; difficulty values are author labels, not psychometrically validated.
assessmentJudgment.retrieval: Card fronts and answers aligned; last3 retained synthesis cards are concise and clinically compatible. No image-question claim is made by the self-contained written vignettes.

limits: Acceptance applies to this full original assessment pool and its checked teaching parity, not all HRCT banks or the whole Thorax PDF.
